title: Strong evidence: ML pipeline and batch scoring service
provenance: Written for this evaluation. Not copied from any real job posting or resume.
job_description:
Machine Learning Engineer - Customer Analytics

Join a small team that turns customer data into models the business can use every day. You will train and evaluate models with scikit-learn and gradient boosting libraries, track experiments, and expose models through APIs.

Responsibilities:
- Build feature pipelines in Python and SQL.
- Deploy models as containerised services.
- Monitor model quality and document experiments.

Requirements:
- Python and SQL.
- scikit-learn and experience deploying a model behind an API.
- Docker and clear written communication.

Nice to have: Airflow for scheduling and Apache Spark for large datasets. Candidates who have run models in production for more than 2 years are preferred.
